profile.headline: Software Engineer & Attorney

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack developer utilizing various languages (Python, Java, Javascript, JSON, Python, Dremel, CSS, HTML, SQL) to work on various projects related to Google’s Flight and Hotels division.
Developed written plans for projects spanning over the course of weeks; delegated work as necessary.
Implemented various tools for monitoring, analytics, and debugging. 
Conducted phone and whiteboard interviews for 50+ software engineering candidates.
Created integration tests for servers receiving millions of requests a day and interacting with 20+ external servers. 
Utilized machine learning (via TensorFlow – linear regression) to create a ranking algorithm for flight and hotel combinations based on CTRs and user engagement. Increased CTRs by 71%.
Worked in conjunction with Google's Senior Counsel on Civil and Human Rights Malika Saada Saar to remove predatory bail ads on Google Search and raise money to bail out those wrongfully imprisoned.
Led two diversity-related employee resource groups (doing so required sticking to a budget, planning events with 100+ attendees, coordinating efforts amongst 15 colleagues across 3 offices, planning community outreach, and soliciting volunteers).

positions.title: Boston Police Camera Action Team
positions.description:
- BPCAT is an ACLU-affiliated grassroots organization with the goal of regulation police body cameras in Boston. See bpcat.org for details. Recognition of impact has been documented in multiple Boston news sources. 
- Utilize media and local events to disseminate information on body cameras and put pressure on political decision makers to consider and incorporate BPCAT’s stances and recommendations.
- Received the Next Generation Leadership award from the NAACP on behalf of BPCAT

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: I worked on front-end and back-end development for Zynga's Poker studio. I developed features and code to make live changes using the Facebook App platform (for both mobile and web) for a live game. Languages used include mySQL, ActionScript, PHP, and javascript. Technologies and Dev cycle software used includes Phabricator, git, LAMP, SmartFox, and JIRA.
